phases.name: Immediate Recovery - Protected Movement
phases.focus: Re-establish gentle movement, breathing and pelvic floor activation while respecting surgical healing and OB restrictions.

phases.name: Foundational Movement & Core Re-education
phases.focus: Progress mobility, walking conditioning and gentle core/pelvic floor re-education avoiding loaded abdominal work until clearance.

phases.name: Progressive Strength & Conditioning Intro
phases.focus: Introduce safer resisted and standing functional strength patterns, increase walking conditioning and gradually prepare for heavier loading post-clearance.

phases.name: Consolidation & Return to Regular Training
phases.focus: Consolidate gains, transition toward normalised core and strength work contingent on medical clearance for heavier lifting.

non_negotiables: OB cleared for light activity only — walking, no abs, no heavy lifting until the six-week check
No abdominal exercises (no 'abs') until cleared at six-week check
No heavy lifting until cleared at six-week check
Train only at home with available equipment: yoga mat (no additional equipment required)

stage2.text:
PLAN "12-week Postpartum Return (4 weeks post C-section start)"
TYPE workout
VISIBILITY public
GOALS
  GOAL primary rehabilitation:
    name "Safe postpartum return to movement and progressive strength"
PHASES
  PHASE "Immediate Recovery - Protected Movement" (2 weeks):
    WEEK 1:
      DAY Walk_PF training 20m "Walk + Pelvic floor/breathing":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x5 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          pelvic_tilt 3x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          diaphragmatic_breathing 3x6 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          cat_cow 5m
      DAY Mobility_Mat training 25m "Gentle mobility & low-load strength (mat-based)":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          bird_dog 3x6 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          glute_bridge 3x8 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
          hip_abduction 2x10 rpe 2 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          child_pose 5m
      DAY Active_Recovery training 20m "Active recovery: walk + mobility":
        warmup:
          walking 10m
        main straight_sets:
          leg_swings 2x10 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
          hip_circles 2x8 rpe 2 rest 20 seconds
        cooldown:
          forward_fold 5m
      DAY Functional_Standing training 25m "Functional standing strength & conditioning (bodyweight/progressive)":
        warmup:
          marching 3m
        main straight_sets:
          squat 3x6 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          step_up 2x8 rpe 3 rest 45 seconds
          standing_calf_raise 2x12 rpe 3 rest 30 seconds
        cooldown:
          quad_stretch 5m
    WEEK 2:
